title: 第5章 兵煞炼魂幡 古战场万魂归吾续第6章 白骨战场上
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
白骨战场，死气凝滞如铅汞。
阴九幽拄着白骨幡杆，每一步都踏碎枯骨，留下燃烧着魂焰的漆黑脚印。
杆顶黑幡虚影无声旋转，吞噬着战场边缘残余的兵煞怨气，气息愈发凝练、凶戾。
他的目光穿透翻涌的黑气，死死钉在祭坛中央那尊低垂头颅的金甲骸骨之上——
暗金魂火熊熊，如同两轮沉沦的落日，散发着令万魂俯首的王者威严。
“擅…闯…王…域…者…死！”
那宏大的意念再次如重锤砸落！
阴九幽闷哼，嘴角溢血，脚下白骨又陷深寸许！
周身魂元黑气被压缩得紧贴皮肤，发出不堪重负的滋滋声。
万魂幡虚影在识海中疯狂震颤，传递出既渴望又忌惮的意志。
“王魂…归吾！”
他喉咙里滚出沙哑的嘶吼，眼中疯狂与贪婪交织。
腹背受敌又如何？这金甲战魂，便是他破局的关键！
更是万魂幡登临绝顶的无上资粮！
他不再犹豫，猛地将白骨幡杆插入脚下骸骨祭坛！
“万魂…噬灵！”
嗡——！
杆顶黑幡虚影骤然膨胀！
化作一面三丈高的巨大魔幡，猎猎招展！
幡面之上，无数被吞噬的兵煞战魂虚影疯狂咆哮、挣扎，却如同被无形的锁链束缚，化作推动巨幡运转的燃料！

一股远超之前的恐怖吞噬之力，混合着战场积累的滔天怨煞，化作无形的滔天巨浪，狠狠撞向祭坛中央的金甲骸骨！
轰隆！
整个白骨祭坛剧烈震颤！
堆积如山的骸骨发出令人牙酸的呻吟！
金甲骸骨低垂的头颅猛地抬起！
空洞眼窝中的暗金魂火骤然炽烈，如同被彻底激怒！
一股远比之前更加狂暴、更加纯粹的兵戈杀伐之气轰然爆发！
如同沉睡的远古巨神睁开了眼！
“蝼…蚁…安敢…渎…神！”
宏大的意念带着碾碎一切的愤怒！
金甲骸骨那紧握断剑的骨手猛地向下一按！
咔嚓！
插在它身前的半截暗金巨剑嗡鸣震颤，一道凝练到极致、仿佛能斩裂虚空的金色剑煞，撕裂粘稠的死气，无视了空间距离，瞬间斩至阴九幽头顶！
剑煞未至，那锋锐无匹的意念已让阴九幽头皮欲裂，灵魂剧痛！
“煞盾！”
阴九幽瞳孔骤缩，嘶声厉啸！
万魂幡虚影疯狂旋转，无数兵煞战魂虚影瞬间燃烧、湮灭！
磅礴的魂元与战场煞气被强行抽取，在他头顶凝聚成一面厚达三尺、翻涌着无数痛苦面孔的漆黑巨盾！
嗤——！
content_en:
In the battlefield of bones, the dead air is as stagnant as lead and mercury.
Yin Jiuyou leaned on the white bone flag pole, crushing dead bones with every step, leaving behind dark footprints burning with soul flames.
The shadow of the black flag on the top of the pole rotated silently, swallowing up the remaining resentment of the soldiers on the edge of the battlefield, and the aura became more condensed and fierce.
His gaze penetrated the surging black energy and was fixed on the golden armored skeleton with its head lowered in the center of the altar——
The dark gold soul is blazing with fire, like two sinking sunsets, exuding the majesty of a king that makes all souls bow.
"Those who trespass into the king's territory will die!"
That grand idea struck down like a heavy hammer again!
Yin Jiuyou groaned, blood bleeded from the corner of his mouth, and the bones beneath his feet were sunken an inch deeper!
The black energy of the soul around the body was compressed so tightly that it clung to the skin, making an overwhelming sizzling sound.
The phantom of the Ten Thousand Soul Banner trembled crazily in the sea of ​​consciousness, conveying a will that was both eager and fearful.
"The king's soul... returns to me!"
A hoarse roar rolled out of his throat, and madness and greed intertwined in his eyes.
So what if we are attacked from both sides? This golden-armored fighting spirit is the key to his victory!
It is the supreme qualification for Ten Thousand Soul Banner to reach the top!
He no longer hesitated, and suddenly inserted the bone flag pole into the bone altar at his feet!
"Ten Thousand Souls...Eating Souls!"
Buzz—!
The shadow of the black flag on the top of the pole suddenly expanded!
It turned into a huge demonic flag three feet high and spread out wildly!
Above the flag, countless phantoms of the swallowed soldiers and evil spirits roared and struggled wildly, but they seemed to be bound by invisible chains and turned into fuel to drive the giant flag!
A terrifying devouring power that far exceeded the previous one, mixed with the overwhelming resentment accumulated on the battlefield, turned into an invisible huge wave, and slammed into the golden-armored skeleton in the center of the altar!
Boom!
The entire Bone Altar shook violently!
The mountains of skeletons let out a heart-wrenching groan!
The lowered head of the golden-armored skeleton suddenly lifted up!
The dark gold soul fire in the empty eye sockets suddenly became blazing, as if he was completely angered!
A far more violent and pure fighting spirit than before suddenly erupted!
It's like the sleeping ancient giant opened its eyes!
"How dare you... ant... dare... blaspheme... God!"
Magnificent ideas with anger that crushes everything!
The bone hand of the golden-armored skeleton holding the broken sword suddenly pressed down!
Click!
The half of the dark gold giant sword inserted in front of it buzzed and trembled, and a golden sword that was so condensed that it seemed to be able to cut through the void tore through the sticky death energy, ignored the distance in space, and instantly cut to the top of Yin Jiuyou's head!
Before the evil sword arrived, the sharp thoughts had already made Yin Jiuyou's scalp split and his soul suffered severe pain!
"Shadow!"
Yin Jiuyou's pupils shrank suddenly and he screamed loudly!
The phantoms of the Ten Thousand Soul Banners rotated crazily, and the phantoms of countless soldiers and evil spirits burned and annihilated instantly!
The majestic soul energy and battlefield evil energy were forcibly extracted, and condensed into a three-foot-thick black shield above his head, filled with countless painful faces!
laugh--!
